description: This file defines custom placement strategies and attributes for Orleans grains to support version-aware placement. It includes an attribute class for associating the version-aware strategy with grain classes and a singleton class representing the placement strategy.

classes.name: VersionAwareStrategyAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute to associate a version-aware placement strategy with a grain class, derived from PlacementAttribute.

classes.name: VersionAwarePlacementStrategy
classes.description: Represents a singleton instance of a version-aware placement strategy, derived from PlacementStrategy.

methods.name: VersionAwareStrategyAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the attribute with a singleton placement strategy.

methods.name: VersionAwarePlacementStrategy
methods.description: Static property providing a singleton instance of the placement strategy.
